items.title: No more Nordisk: Novo’s latest trim is in its name
items.summary: Joining a minimalistic wave in pharma marketing, Novo said the change increases memorability and relevance.

items.title: Pressure intensifies on Novartis as bolt-on deal strategy faces major test
items.summary: Share prices tumbled last week after a key asset from Novartis’ $12bn Avidity deal fumbled in a Phase III trial.

items.title: Scholar Rock’s muscle-targeting SMA therapy Isemblyd lands FDA approval
items.summary: GlobalData analysts predicts that myostatin inhibitors like Isemblyd will be key drivers of growth within the SMA market in years to come.

items.title: The rare disease revolution: The state of play for CGTs in orphan diseases
items.summary: Cell and gene therapies are fuelling new possibilities for rare diseases, turning a field defined by unmet need into one of the industry’s most dynamic areas of innovation.

items.title: HIV charities lament NICE snub for Gilead’s twice-yearly lenacapavir
items.summary: Though yet to be finalised, the initial recommendation would mean the injectable PrEP would not be covered on the NHS.
